verdicts.evidence: (1) Repro repro/A5-verify/repro.sh (output repro.out): disposable PG18 on 55705, all 218 migrations applied with apps/backend/scripts/migrate.mjs, one fleet_proxies row inserted, scrub.sql run as sync.sh does (single transaction, ON_ERROR_STOP, empty search_path) -> 'ERROR: null value in column "url_enc" of relation "fleet_proxies" violates not-null constraint', CONTEXT 'UPDATE public.fleet_proxies SET url_enc = NULL WHERE url_enc IS NOT NULL', and env_marker is absent afterwards, so the transaction rolled back. (2) Railway get-logs (read-only), project recycle-erp-experiment, env b20fb714, service db-sync 006cd405: the 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-27 runs log '[sync] done' (10-27 also 'fleet restored after 30s'); the 2026-10-28, 10-29, 10-30 and 10-31 ~04:02Z runs each log that same url_enc NOT NULL error and no '[sync] done'. (3) Code: scrub.sql:34-47 nulls every *_enc column; migrations/0213_fleet_proxies.sql:14 'url_enc TEXT NOT NULL', and no later migration relaxes it. tests/sync-scrub.test.ts seeds no fleet_proxies row, so CI never hits the failure.
verdicts.reason: The claim holds exactly as stated: 4 consecutive nightly failures, and dev's data has been frozen at the 2026-10-27 copy since. sync.sh:106-116 pipes keep-fleet, the dump and scrub through 'psql --single-transaction --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1', so the error rolls everything back. Nothing on dev is wiped and no prod credentials leak, so P1 isn't warranted. It is still a real, growing break in a supported ops flow that repeats every night until scrub.sql or the column constraint changes, so P2 stands.
